window_start_utc.conversion: convert to UTC using fixed offset

wave_height_mean.flagging_rule: suspect if above 25 meters or below 0 meters

wave_height_max.flagging_rule: suspect if above 25 meters or below 0 meters

tide_stage.source: derived from tide gauge reading using published thresholds

spike_sequences.rule: replace spike sequences shorter than three consecutive samples with median and flag corrected

long_excursions.rule: keep longer excursions as observations and flag suspect

wind_directions.rule: normalize wind direction to range 0-360 degrees

local_time_shift.rule: shift local time readings to UTC using fixed offset

gap_handling.gap_mask_representation: missing values represented as nulls in Parquet
gap_handling.forbid_interpolation: interpolation across gaps longer than forty minutes is forbidden
gap_handling.linear_interpolation: linear interpolation for shorter gaps with interpolated values flagged corrected

validation_invariants.no_duplicate_station_window_pairs: each station-window pair must appear only once in the output table
validation_invariants.window_starts_aligned_to_ten_minute_boun: window starts must be aligned to ten-minute boundaries
validation_invariants.wind_direction_within_range_after_normal: normalized wind direction must be within range 0-360 degrees
validation_invariants.quality_flags_drawn_only_from_closed_set: quality flags must be drawn only from the closed sets ['good', 'suspect', 'corrected', 'missing']
validation_invariants.every_target_column_present_with_declare: all target columns must be present with the declared physical units
validation_invariants.row_counts_per_station_per_month_reconci: row counts per station per month must reconcile against the count of raw records adjusted for windowing

reproducibility.sorting_by_station_then_window_before_an: sort by station then window before any aggregation
reproducibility.fixed_precision_decimal_formatting_for_f: use fixed-precision decimal formatting for floats before Parquet serialization
reproducibility.stated_rule_for_tie_breaking_identical_t: tie-breaking identical timestamps within a window occurs because the two wave sensors on some stations report independently
